title: Filterhound
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A relentless 909 kick with panning hi-hats drives a sawtooth bassline in C minor whose filter sweeps open and shut across six distinct sections, building from bare groove to full clap-and-open-hat intensity before a stripped breakdown and a final reassembled peak. Melody lines in the upper register enter midway, adding harmonic motion before the arrangement winds back down to its bare bones.
code:
setcpm(122/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.85),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(220, 1200)).resonance(11).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.85)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").room(0.3).gain(0.55),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(300, 2400)).resonance(12).decay(0.13).sustain(0).gain(0.9)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.95),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").room(0.35).gain(0.6),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(400, 2600)).resonance(13).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.95),
    n("<7 9 11 12>").scale("C4:minor").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(12).range(800, 3000)).decay(0.2).sustain(0).delay(0.3).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").room(0.5).gain(0.55),
    note("<c2 eb2 g1 bb1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(250, 1400)).resonance(10).decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).room(0.4).gain(0.8),
    n("0 ~ 3 ~ 7 ~ 5 ~").scale("C4:minor").s("sawtooth").decay(0.25).sustain(0).delay(0.4).room(0.3).gain(0.45)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.95),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").room(0.35).gain(0.6),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(500, 3000)).resonance(13).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.95),
    n("<7 9 11 12 9 7 5 4>").scale("C4:minor").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(1000, 3400)).decay(0.18).sustain(0).delay(0.3).pan(0.4).gain(0.5)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.8),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(12).range(200, 900)).resonance(10).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.8)
  )]
)
